author: D2 (Lane D)
slice: Paired / double connectors. Vietnamese marks subordination on BOTH clauses (vi...nen = because...so; tuy / mac du...nhung = although...but), so learners keep both members in English, which allows only one. Each pattern drops the redundant second connector and keeps the leading subordinator.
claimCheck: Confirmed non-overlapping at generation time with: d1/vn-corpus-prep-phrasal (verb/adjective prepositions + particles), d1/vn-corpus-structural (existential there-is, dummy-it, adjective-noun order, comparatives), lane-a/vn-corpus-a3-build-queue (tense-aspect, question-form, copula-drop, intra-clause word order, topic-comment), and the A1/A4 corpora already on main (articles, plural/countability, time prepositions, make/do + lexical sense-merges, appliance/medicine calques). Inter-clausal paired connectors are claimed by none of them.
verificationMethod: Every positive and negative below was run through the UNMODIFIED live engine (correctWithTutorRules, language 'en') on origin/main @ 52523909d. 'liveEngine.marker' = 'fires' when a proposed/related ruleId appears in appliedRuleIds, else 'abstains'. 'liveEngine.corrected' is the engine's verbatim current output. No engine code is changed by this MR; it is data-only.

coverageLegend.gap_new_rule_needed: Engine currently abstains on the positives; a new rule must be authored to reach expectedCorrection. Negatives confirm the engine already abstains on the confusable surface (no current false positive to guard).

patterns.name: because...so redundancy (drop clause-initial 'so')
patterns.vietnameseRoot: vi...nen (vi troi mua nen toi o nha = because it rained so I stayed home)
patterns.fp_risk_note: Medium-high. 'so' is high-frequency: intensifier ('so tired'), result connector opening a SEPARATE main clause that has no leading 'because' ('She studied hard, so she passed.'), and purpose 'so that'. Fire ONLY on the wrap shape 'Because <clause>, so <clause>' where a sentence-initial subordinator 'because' governs clause 1 and a clause-initial 'so' opens clause 2. Must NOT touch 'because of', 'so that', or 'so' + adjective.
patterns.detectorSketch: detect: /^\s*because\b[^,]*,\s*so\b/i AND not /\bso that\b/i. apply: delete the clause-initial 'so ' immediately after the first comma (Because X, so Y -> Because X, Y), preserving the rest verbatim. Anchor on sentence-initial 'because' so mid-sentence '..., so ... because ...' (CONN-1 neg-001) never matches.

positive.input: Because it rained, so I stayed home.
positive.expectedCorrection: Because it rained, I stayed home.

liveEngine.corrected: Because it rained, so I stayed home.

positive.notes: Gap: engine abstains. Target drops the clause-initial 'so'.

positive.input: Because he was tired, so he slept.
positive.expectedCorrection: Because he was tired, he slept.

liveEngine.corrected: Because he was tired, so he slept.

positive.notes: Gap: engine abstains. Past-tense clause kept intact; only 'so' removed.

positive.input: Because she is busy, so she cannot come.
positive.expectedCorrection: Because she is busy, she cannot come.

liveEngine.corrected: Because she is busy, so she cannot come.

positive.notes: Gap: engine abstains. Modal 'cannot' clause preserved.

negative.input: I was tired, so I went to bed because I needed rest.
negative.expectedCorrection: I was tired, so I went to bed because I needed rest.

liveEngine.corrected: I was tired, so I went to bed because I needed rest.

negative.notes: Confusable: 'so' and 'because' both present but NOT a wrap pair — 'so' opens the main clause, 'because' subordinates a trailing reason. No sentence-initial 'because...,so'. Engine verified abstains.

negative.input: He is so tired because of work.
negative.expectedCorrection: He is so tired because of work.

liveEngine.corrected: He is so tired because of work.

negative.notes: Confusable: 'so' = intensifier, 'because of' = preposition. Engine verified abstains.

negative.input: She studied hard, so she passed.
negative.expectedCorrection: She studied hard, so she passed.

liveEngine.corrected: She studied hard, so she passed.

negative.notes: Confusable: correct single result-'so' with no leading 'because'. Engine verified abstains.

patterns.buildQueuePlacement: After the existing single-connector / topic-comment rules; group with CONN-2 and CONN-3 as one paired-connector rule-pack. Medium priority: high learner frequency, but needs the comma-anchored guard before locking.

patterns.name: although...but redundancy (drop clause-initial 'but')
patterns.vietnameseRoot: tuy / mac du...nhung (tuy troi mua nhung toi van di = although it rained but I still went)
patterns.fp_risk_note: Medium. 'but' is high-frequency: correct contrastive coordinator with no 'although' ('I tried, but I failed.'), and exception sense in 'nothing/anything/all but'. Fire ONLY when a sentence-initial 'although' or 'though' governs clause 1 and a clause-initial 'but' opens clause 2. Exclude the 'X but Y' coordinator with no leading subordinator, and the '<neg-quantifier> but' exception idiom. Keep token set {although, though} distinct from CONN-3's {even though}.
patterns.detectorSketch: detect: /^\s*(although|though)\b[^,]*,\s*but\b/i AND not preceded by 'even'. apply: delete the clause-initial 'but ' after the first comma (Although X, but Y -> Although X, Y). Sentence-initial anchor keeps 'I tried, but I failed.' (no leading subordinator) and 'nothing but' (no comma + subordinator) out.

positive.input: Although it rained, but I still went.
positive.expectedCorrection: Although it rained, I still went.

liveEngine.corrected: Although it rained, but I still went.

positive.notes: Gap: engine abstains. Drop the clause-initial 'but'.

positive.input: Although he is rich, but he is not happy.
positive.expectedCorrection: Although he is rich, he is not happy.

liveEngine.corrected: Although he is rich, but he is not happy.

positive.notes: Gap: engine abstains. Negated predicate 'is not happy' preserved.

positive.input: Although she was sick, but she came to work.
positive.expectedCorrection: Although she was sick, she came to work.

liveEngine.corrected: Although she was sick, but she came to work.

positive.notes: Gap: engine abstains. Past clause preserved.

negative.notes: Confusable: correct single contrastive 'but', no leading 'although'. Engine verified abstains.

negative.input: Although it was hard, I finished.
negative.expectedCorrection: Although it was hard, I finished.

liveEngine.corrected: Although it was hard, I finished.

negative.notes: Confusable: correctly formed 'although' with NO redundant 'but'. Rule must leave it untouched. Engine verified abstains.

negative.input: He said nothing but the truth.
negative.expectedCorrection: He said nothing but the truth.

liveEngine.corrected: He said nothing but the truth.

negative.notes: Confusable: 'but' = except ('nothing but'), not a contrastive connector; no leading subordinator. Engine verified abstains.

patterns.buildQueuePlacement: Group with CONN-1 / CONN-3 paired-connector rule-pack. Medium priority.

patterns.name: even though / though...but redundancy (drop clause-initial 'but')
patterns.vietnameseRoot: mac du / cho du...nhung (mac du toi hoc nhung toi truot = even though I studied but I failed)
patterns.fp_risk_note: Medium. Same 'but' frequency risk as CONN-2 plus overlap risk: the subordinator 'even though' contains 'though', so this rule and CONN-2 must be mutually exclusive — match the longest subordinator first ('even though' here; bare 'although'/'though' in CONN-2). Exclude exception 'nothing/anything but' and standalone contrastive 'X but Y'.
patterns.detectorSketch: detect: /^\s*even though\b[^,]*,\s*but\b/i (longest-match before CONN-2's bare though/although). apply: delete the clause-initial 'but ' after the first comma. Order the rule-pack so 'even though' is tested before 'though' to avoid double-fire.

positive.input: Even though I studied, but I failed.
positive.expectedCorrection: Even though I studied, I failed.

liveEngine.corrected: Even though I studied, but I failed.

positive.notes: Gap: engine abstains. Drop the clause-initial 'but'.

positive.input: Though it was late, but she kept working.
positive.expectedCorrection: Though it was late, she kept working.

liveEngine.corrected: Though it was late, but she kept working.

positive.notes: Gap: engine abstains. 'Though' (bare) + 'but' wrap; covered by this pack's though-branch.

positive.input: Even though he apologized, but she was still angry.
positive.expectedCorrection: Even though he apologized, she was still angry.

liveEngine.corrected: Even though he apologized, but she was still angry.

positive.notes: Gap: engine abstains. Concessive clause preserved.

negative.input: Even though it was raining, we went outside.
negative.expectedCorrection: Even though it was raining, we went outside.

liveEngine.corrected: Even though it was raining, we went outside.

negative.notes: Confusable: correctly formed 'even though' with NO redundant 'but'. Must stay untouched. Engine verified abstains.

negative.input: I have nothing but a pen.
negative.expectedCorrection: I have nothing but a pen.

liveEngine.corrected: I have nothing but a pen.

negative.notes: Confusable: 'but' = except; no leading subordinator. Engine verified abstains.

negative.input: It is not cheap but it is worth it.
negative.expectedCorrection: It is not cheap but it is worth it.

liveEngine.corrected: It is not cheap but it is worth it.

negative.notes: Confusable: single contrastive 'but', no leading 'though/even though'. Engine verified abstains.

patterns.buildQueuePlacement: Group with CONN-1 / CONN-2 paired-connector rule-pack; order 'even though' before bare 'though'/'although' to avoid double-fire. Medium priority.
